rules.governing: Determine component load capacities from the applicable tables (anchorage, glazing, mullions, jambs, heads, sills, intermediate horizontals, door assemblies); the LEAST capacity applies to the entire system (sheet 1 note).
rules.pressure_basis: ASD; capacities are Ext.(+) and Int.(-) PSF, limited by ASTM E-1300 glass tables and tested pressures (general note 6).
rules.mullion_height: Max. mullion height; opening height = mullion height + 1-3/8" max; frame height = mullion height + 5/8" (sheet 7 drawing).
rules.infill_size: Infill size formula: DLO + 1 1/8" unless otherwise noted (sheet 4 glazing note 1).
general_notes: Tested to AAMA 501 and TAS 201/202/203; meets FBC incl. HVHZ (note 1).
Any number of panels horizontally provided max DLO sizes are not exceeded (note 3).
Required design pressures are determined per project from code and governing wind speed (note 5).
Capacities are ASD; alternate comparative/rational analysis by the engineer of record is acceptable (note 6).
Dissimilar materials (e.g. fasteners vs pressure-treated wood or aluminum) must be coated/protected (note 7).
Water infiltration sealing/flashing is NOT within the scope of this approval; by others (note 8).
4/3 stress increase not used in anchor analysis; 1.6 Cd factor used for wood substrate (note 9).
Substrate structural integrity and wood bucks by others / AHJ (note 10).
Min. 1-1/2" center-to-center spacing between any two installation fasteners (note 11).
Anchor embedment beyond wall dressing/stucco and fully into substrate; load-bearing shims at every anchor location where gap > 1/16"; max shim gap as indicated (note 12).
Substrates must meet Table 1 minimums; concrete/masonry must not be cracked; metal substrates need threads through plus 3/16" min. (note 13).
Vertical members run through; horizontals are coped and butted to verticals (note 14).
evaluation_report_limits: Glazing types G-A..G-D approved for Large Missile Level D, G-E for Large Missile Level E, G-F for Small Missile Level A.
Interlayers limited to Kuraray SentryGlas, Kuraray Trosifol PVB, Eastman Saflex PVB, Eastman Saflex Storm (VS02), as indicated in IR521-FPA per current Miami-Dade NOA.
As-tested 6063-T6 aluminum extrusions with or without steel reinforcement as indicated.
